# ADR-3070: A06: Prefer private package mirrors for build farm 10

## Status

Accepted

## Context

Normative language in the Decision section follows RFC 2119 (Bradner, S., "Key words for use in RFCs to Indicate Requirement Levels", BCP 14, March 1997).

Public registries can be unavailable or tampered.

## Decision

Platforms SHOULD prefer private package mirrors for build farm 10 (A06-10) where upstream availability is a risk.

## Consequences

Mirrors verify upstream checksums.
